description: Open a local project: an ESP-IDF project (a folder whose CMakeLists.txt includes ESP-IDF's project.cmake) or, since protocol 0.45, the user's own Arduino sketch (a folder holding <folder>.ino, or that file), built in place with arduino-cli for a board from the library (kind arduino). The core remembers it (local.list) and returns it with its id, which then works wherever a library project id does: build.start builds it with idf.py (no consent: the user chose the folder), and sim.start, board.flash and circuit.* use the build. Opening it again returns the same id. Nothing is written to the folder.

id.description: local- and a hash of the folder's path; used as a project id by build.start, sim.start, board.flash and circuit.*.

name.description: From project(<name>) in the project's CMakeLists.txt.

kind.description: Since protocol 0.45: what builds it: idf.py for a chip (absent in older cores: idf), or arduino-cli for a library board (the user's own Arduino sketch, a folder with <folder>.ino).
